title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. You will be responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining our data pipelines and data warehouse architecture to support data scientists and business analysts. You will work with large-scale datasets and ensure high data quality and availability.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various sources (APIs, databases, logs) into our Data Warehouse.

Optimize database performance and query tuning for high-volume data processing.

Implement data governance and data quality monitoring to ensure accuracy.

Collaborate with Data Scientists to deploy machine learning models into production.

Manage cloud infrastructure and resources for data processing.

Must-Have Requirements (Hard Skills):

Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in Data Engineering.

Programming: Proficient in Python (Pandas, NumPy) and advanced SQL skills.

Big Data Technologies: Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Hadoop, or Kafka.

Orchestration: Experience with workflow management tools like Apache Airflow or Dagster.

Cloud Platform: Strong experience with AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda) or GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow).

Data Warehousing: Experience designing schemas (Star/Snowflake) in Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills):

Experience with Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Knowledge of IaC (Infrastructure as Code) using Terraform.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts.

Soft Skills:

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Good communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to work independently in an Agile environment.
